unit_notes.estimator_note: A selection is estimated by the arithmetic difference in differences the city published: for each treated unit, the change in its annual count minus the mean change at its own comparison locations, averaged over the selection and tested against zero by a one sample t test. That is exact arithmetic on the sums shipped here.
unit_notes.ratio_note: The aggregate rate ratio shown beside it is the ratio of summed counts, (total after at treated / total before at treated) divided by the same at the comparison locations. It is NOT the fixed effects Poisson estimate reported in the manuscript: it carries no unit effects, no calendar month effects and no cluster robust variance. Read it as a descriptive summary of the selection and read the manuscript tables for the modelled quantity.
unit_notes.matching_note: Comparison intersections were matched once, over the union of treated units, because a browser cannot rematch for an arbitrary selection. The pipeline matches separately for every subset, so a selection that coincides with a published subset will differ slightly from the published estimate for it.
unit_notes.censoring_note: Only installations from 2015-07 to 2024-05 are included, because 24 months of crash record must exist after an installation for the after window to be filled. Recent work, including the whole of the 2025 published list, is therefore absent from any selection here.

mechanism_note.narrowing: narrows the turning path with a physical object
mechanism_note.vertical: slows the turn with a vertical deflection rather than narrowing it
mechanism_note.post: vertical posts, which are visible but weakly physical
mechanism_note.paint: paint only, with no physical object, so a driver may ignore it
mechanism_note.unpublished: a turn was treated and the city does not publish what was installed
